name: u11-dark-shield-puncher
description: ⛓⛓⛓ U11-swim D3 — THE DARK SHIELD HITS A PUNCHER: DAMAGE WITH NO SHOVE. L12, U9's puncher boot (384,256), the shield and the DARK shield through the seam and `noDamage` FALSE; `right` for 40 ticks, then still for 20. `shieldBump` calls `Enemy.hit(5, playerPoint, 0.5, "Shield")` on `puncher@416,256` on t 13: it takes 0.5 and a 30-tick i-frame, and `Puncher.knockback` is an EMPTY override, so nothing moves. Inside that i-frame the player walks through the puncher untouched — where the plain shield (`u9-shield-puncher`) takes the contact on t 15 and the punch on t 35. Fixed keys.
